effect: An inconclusive investigation can satisfy its bounded criteria without a claimed fix or established cause.

semantic.criterion: The PR accounts for E1–E3 through the completed log comparison, bounded replay and report, and connects them to their retained evidence at the report revision.
It says the cause remains unknown and the replay did not reproduce the symptom; it does not claim retries caused duplicates, duplicates were fixed, or the bug is absent.
It presents added research findings and a proposed follow-up, without implying production behavior changed or the follow-up was approved.
It permits the bounded investigation to be complete despite the inconclusive cause, without treating lack of a fix as failure of these exploratory criteria.
